_doc: Deck structure templates for Pollinate Track E. These are REFERENCE PATTERNS — slide count is content-driven, not capped by template.

pitch.name: Internal Pitch
pitch.description: Structured argument for getting buy-in on a direction
pitch.notes: Evidence slides repeat — one per key point. Never compress multiple points into one slide.

conference.name: Conference Talk
conference.description: Knowledge sharing with progressive insight building

flow.purpose: surprising claim or contradiction to grab attention
frame the problem / why audience should care
what this means for the audience's work
what to try / where to learn more

conference.notes: Insight slides are the core. Each builds on the previous. Never rush through them.

mbr.name: MBR / Business Review
mbr.description: Data-driven review with metrics, trends, and action items

flow.purpose: top 3-5 KPIs with traffic light status
drill into anomaly or key trend
committed next steps with owners and dates
what to watch for next period

mbr.notes: Data slides: chart dominates, insight sentence is one line max. Never 5 bullets explaining a chart.

proposal.name: Customer Proposal

flow.purpose: customer's problem stated in their language
what the world looks like after the solution
mechanism — how the solution works (3 steps max)
exact CTA — what to do right now

proposal.notes: Proof slides: concrete numbers, named customers (if allowed), specific outcomes. Never generic 'customers love it'.
